issues: 渲染穿帮：依赖 backface-visibility，Chromium 在首行/首列把灰背也剔掉，开场五张卡“隐身”
perspective 挂在 grid 上、隔了一层未 preserve-3d 的格子，翻转实际是正交的，没有纵深
灰背是平涂灰块 + 一个圆点；阴影挂在旋转体上跟着卡面一起转
翻面过程没有受光变化；工作台按 150f 渲染，比卡片设定的 130f 多出死帧
changes: 按角度显式只画朝外那面（<90° 灰背、≥90° 正面），确定性无剔除问题
每格自带 perspective 2400px、perspectiveOrigin 换算到整墙中心，整墙真正共享一个消失点
灰背改为哑光纸感卡（微渐变、斜纹、压印标记、发丝线）；阴影改为格位下方独立地面影，随翻转抬起变大变虚、落定收紧
翻面按 cos(角度) 压暗，最薄处高光线保留；补 GRID_WAVE_FLIP_DURATION = 130，波前与尾张过冲参数不变
issuesEn: Render bug: relying on backface-visibility, Chromium culled the grey backs in the first row and column, so five cards were invisible at the start
Perspective sat on the grid with a non-preserve-3d cell in between, so the flips were effectively orthographic with no depth
The back was a flat grey block with a dot, and the shadow rotated along with the card
No lighting change during the flip; the workbench rendered 150f instead of the card's 130f
changesEn: Each frame draws only the outward face by angle (<90° back, ≥90° front), deterministic with no culling issues
Every cell carries perspective 2400px with perspectiveOrigin mapped to the wall center, so the wall truly shares one vanishing point

The back is now a matte paper card (subtle gradient, diagonal texture, debossed mark, hairline); the shadow is a separate floor shadow under each slot that grows and softens with lift and tightens on landing
Faces darken by cos(angle) while turning; the edge-on highlight line stays; added GRID_WAVE_FLIP_DURATION = 130 with wavefront and tail overshoot unchanged
